mechanism: Haloperidol can cause hypokalemia through increased urinary potassium loss and antagonism of potassium channels, while potassium supplementation may be needed to prevent cardiac arrhythmias, particularly QT prolongation that haloperidol independently causes.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly and maintain adequate potassium supplementation; consider ECG monitoring as both drugs pose cardiac risk, especially with electrolyte imbalance.
